messages.subject: meth.diff form get.methylDiff
parts:
Hi all, 

I have been using methylKit for a while now and I had a stupid question : how the last column (meth.diff) is calculated from the get.methylDiff output? Is it just the difference of the average methylation? is it weighted by the coverage? Sorry I could not find more details about that... 

Thanks! 

Jonathan

by default it is group mean is weighted by coverage, but there is an argument to change that. there were probably related questions in the forum.

Best,
Altuna
